insights.title: Darnold Precision
insights.primary_text: Sam Darnold has completed 68.4% of his passes this season, ranking 5th among qualified quarterbacks.
insights.secondary_text: Darnold has thrown for 2,456 yards and 18 touchdowns in 2024, with only 4 interceptions. His passer rating of 105.2 is a career high.

insights.title: QB Showdown
insights.primary_text: This matchup features two of the top 5 passers in the NFC. Sam Darnold vs. Brock Purdy have a combined 34 TDs this season.
insights.secondary_text: The last time these quarterbacks faced off, the game went to overtime with a combined 856 passing yards.

insights.title: Red Zone Specialist
insights.primary_text: Justin Jefferson leads the league in red zone targets with 24 this season, converting 14 of them into touchdowns.
insights.secondary_text: Jefferson's 58.3% red zone TD rate is the highest in the NFL among receivers with at least 20 targets.

insights.primary_text: The 49ers defense has allowed just 17.2 points per game, ranking 3rd in the NFL.
insights.secondary_text: San Francisco's pass rush has generated 38 sacks this season, with Nick Bosa leading the way with 11.5.

insights.title: Third Down Excellence
insights.primary_text: Minnesota converts 47.8% of third downs, the second-best rate in the league. They are particularly dangerous on 3rd and medium.
insights.secondary_text: Darnold has a 112.4 passer rating on third down, completing 72.3% of his passes when the chains are on the line.

insights.title: Bosa vs. The Pocket
insights.primary_text: Nick Bosa has registered pressure on 22.4% of his pass rush snaps, the highest rate among edge rushers with 200+ snaps.
insights.secondary_text: When Bosa generates pressure, opposing QBs have a passer rating of just 52.3.
